policy: The Android app of the current release and of the three releases published before it. docs/ANDROID_COMPATIBILITY.md explains the fields; scripts/android-support-window.mts checks them.

emulators.why: reported crash on a Pixel with Android 17 (0.21.3)

releases.note: From this app the bridge speaks level 5: calls go through Android's call handling (Core-Telecom), ring while the app is closed and run in a call screen of their own at /call; the lock report sends `capabilities.calls: true` on Android 11 or later. Servers ring a device for calls only when it reports that; older apps ring only while open, in the page.

From this app the bridge speaks level 4: `saveFileStart` takes a target, and a file the page decrypted (a chat's) goes to Android's Open with or Share sheet. The page offers the two only from level 4; older apps save chat files to Downloads.

From this app a chat notification shows its message text (the preview sealed to the phone's push keys), Chat's window refuses screenshots, and the app lock knows the area `chat`. Older apps show "New message", do not block screenshots in Chat and cannot lock Chat: the server refuses Chat on a device that must lock it.

handshake.note: Every shell in the window checks that GET /api/version answers app = "unihub". Shells from 0.22.1 also read features: they offer notifications only while they list android-notifications. Shells from 0.23.0 also read protocol and minApp when connecting: they refuse a protocol other than 1 and a minApp above their own version. So the server must keep app = "unihub", keep listing android-notifications while a shell in the window uses it, keep protocol 1 while a 0.23.0 shell is in the window, and must not raise minApp above the oldest shell here.
